name: Thomas of Woodstock
description: Youngest surviving son of Edward III and Richard II's uncle. Given a special commission alongside the new Chief Justice Robert Tresilian on 20 June 1381 to suppress the revolt and try captured rebels across Essex, with military support -- part of the rapid post-Smithfield reassertion of royal authority.
narrative_function: One of the Crown's chief instruments of suppression once the London phase ends.
